the_finding: BREADTH IS WIDE, DEPTH IS NOT. 1,836 tickers is a real cross-section and 1,695 of them span the whole window - but the window is 82 sessions in a single four-month block, 2024-12-02 to 2025-04-01.

span_the_routes_would_have_to_cover._note: Stated as a coverage fact about the on-disk resource, per T3's instruction to say what a comparison would REQUIRE. No population comparison is drawn and no rate is estimated.

what_a_comparison_would_require: Daily bars for the WHOLE market, not only the 1,836 tickers already on disk. Whether those tickers are a market-wide set or themselves a selected one is NOT established by this audit, and establishing it is part of the work.
Coverage of 2020-01-03 to 2025-10-31, against the 82 sessions present.
A stated rule for what 'previous close' means on each session - ambiguity A1 in screen_definition.json, unresolved.
not_done_here: No false-positive rate, bounded or otherwise, was estimated.
